pin_row_note: pin_row_y is the HEADPIN base row derived in the same frame from the edge lines: the row where lane width = 7-column pin spread (63 px at f462-464: columns 275/286/296-297/307/317-318/327-328/338 = 36 in) x 41.5/36 x 1.043 (headpin 31 in in front of the back row). Read through the reflections the pin bases look ~10-20 px lower; that is the deck reflection.
observed_pin_contact_note: Cut pin_hit_frame 457 is ~6 frames early. f455-461: the ball is drawn over standing, undisturbed pins and is still in front of the rack (lane width at the ball row 75.7-81.8 px vs 75.8 px at the headpin row); f462-464 the ball sits on the headpin column (x 302.5-307.5 vs column 306-307) with the lane width at its row 69-74 px; f465 camera blur, ball hidden among pins; pins tilt by f467 and fly f469-472. Contact 463 +-2. Crops: seq_455_475.jpg, gcgrid_456_465.jpg.

entry.note: Real entry at the observed contact (f463 +-2). Pin ruler: columns 10.5 px apart (6 in = 5.49 board units), headpin column 307 (f462, f463), ball x 307.5 / 306. Ball ruler: board = 20 - (x_ball - x_headpin) x 7.8 / (2r), r 7. The ball moves ~1-2 boards per frame here.

entry_at_cut_pin_hit.note: reads at the cut pin_hit_frame-1/0/+1 as the task named them; the ball is still short of the pins here, so this is NOT the entry board

method: Ball centre and radius read by eye on 3x/5x gridded crops of the SOURCE frames (cv2 seek canary: MAD 1.8 at offset 0 vs 5-12 at +-1), confirmed against a purple/dark blob circle drawn on an overlay; lane edges are the wood-to-gutter-lip step found per row on 5-9 rows of THE SAME FRAME that are clear of the ball and of the pin reflections, fitted as a straight line (residual <=1 px on the far frames, <=4 px near) and evaluated at the ball row y (board) and y+r (board_contact). board = 1 + 38*(x - right_x)/(left_x - right_x); pin ruler uses the 7 pin columns (6 in apart = 5.49 units of lane/38, headpin = 20); ball ruler uses 8.5 in = 7.8 units anchored on the headpin column.
limits: Cut pin_hit_frame 457 is ~6 frames before contact (observed ~463), so the path is extended to f463 and entry.board is read at f463; the cut-frame reads are kept in entry_at_cut_pin_hit. Near the pins the edge lines are extrapolated 28-70 px from rows in front of the deck (slopes 0.27-0.38), ~0.3 board near the lane centre. f406 edges are eye reads, not the automatic step (+-2 px = +-0.3 board). The ball moves 1-2 boards per frame in the last 6 frames, so the +-2 frame contact error is +-2-4 boards of entry. The pin ruler reads 1.5-2.5 boards low while the ball is in front of the pins (cut reads 12.0/13.2 vs edges 13.5-14.7), so only the f462/f463 pin-ruler reads count for entry. Release frame 391 (+-2) unchanged from loop 1; the first path point is release+6.
